title: GameCheckpointPane
responsibility: Describe and edit one checkpoint in a shared modal, with image approval and advanced executable rules.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.context
inputs.description: Selected checkpoint, view, document, project identity, revision and host bridge used by both editors.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.adding
inputs.description: Present the new-checkpoint title and focus its description.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.readonly
inputs.description: Disable editing and generation for historical or otherwise immutable views.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.change
inputs.description: Publishes the complete edited Checkpoint to its owner. The callback returns void; no return value is consumed.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.close
inputs.description: Closes the checkpoint modal through its owner. The callback returns void; no return value is consumed.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointPane.remove
inputs.description: Requests deletion of the selected checkpoint through its owner. The callback returns void; no return value is consumed.

outputs.name: GameCheckpointPane
outputs.description: Shared modal with content-sized title and description textareas, image review, optional advanced rules and owner actions. Long text wraps without an inner field scrollbar; the modal content remains scrollable at normal application viewport heights.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Errors from supplied change, close, remove callbacks or snippets propagate when invoked; this component does not provide an error boundary.
